attributes.title: get_access_matrix
attributes.description: Return the role-to-page access matrix: for every registered page URL, which roles can reach it and why. Already formatted as a Markdown table in 'markdown' -- paste that verbatim rather than rebuilding it, because the cell values carry a distinction you cannot reconstruct from a summary: 'ALL' means the page requires nothing and every session reaches it, which is not the same as a role having been granted access.
